get_minihack_env_ids: get all registered MiniHack environment IDs from the Gymnasium registry excluding skipped environments
rollout_env: run a random policy rollout for a given number of steps and return the final reward
term_screen: convert an observation dictionary tty_chars array into a readable terminal screen string
compare_rollouts: compare two seeded Gymnasium environments step by step to verify identical rollout outputs
test_seed_rollout_seeded: test that two MiniHack environments seeded with the same values produce identical observations and rewards
